page.layout: One printed page of running text (a Greek lexicon page, entries with Latin glosses and Scripture references), with a narrow column of marginal fragments along the right edge of the scan. Page number at the head left, running head "AN" at the head centre. Catchword-like abbreviation "Αvά-" at the foot right of the text block. Right margin holds cropped, mostly illegible notes.

main_text.p: Ἀναλίσκω consumo, destruo. Fut. ἀναλώσω, 2.Thess.2.8. P.ἀνήλωκα. a.1.ἀνήλωσα.
Ἀνάλογος ὁ ἡ insulsus. ex α priv. & ἁλς ἁλὸς ὁ sal, Marc.9.50.
Ἀναλύω resolvo: item revertor. F. ἀναλύσω, Luc.12.16. a.1. ἀνέλυσα. P.ἀναλέλυκα.
Ἀνάλυσις εως ἡ resolutio. item remigratio, 1.Timoth.4.6.
Ἀναμάρτητος ὁ ἡ peccati expers. per syn.gen. immunis ab adulterio, Joh.8.7.
Ἀναμένω exspecto. F. ἀναμενῶ. P. ἀναμεμένηκα. a.1. ἀνέμεινα, 1.Thess.1.10.
Ἀναμιμνήσκω in mentem revoco. F. ἀναμνήσω. P. ἀναμέμνηκα. praes.pass. ἀναμιμνήσκομαι recordor. P. pass. ἀναμέμνημαι. a.1. pass. ἀνεμνήσθην, Marc.14.72.
Ἀνανεόω ῶ renovo. F. ἀνανεώσω. P. ἀνανενέωκα. praes.pass. ἀνανεόομαι renovor, Eph.4.23. Th. νέος ἀον novus a um.
Ἀνανήφω mentis sanitatem recipio. F. ψω. 2.Timoth.2.v.26. P. ἀνανένηφα. aor.1. ἀνένηψα.
Ἀναντιρρήτως ὁ ἡ cui contradici nequit, Act.14.36. ex α priv. & ἀντιρρήτος. λόγος ἀντιρρήτως oratio cui contradicitur. verbum ἀντιρρέω contradico non est in usu.

page.notes: Marginal notes on the right edge are cropped and largely illegible; not transcribed. Greek transcription is approximate in places; the scan's accents and abbreviations may differ from the copied forms.
